[!buildmode:shared] skip
[short] skip
[!cgo] skip '-buildmode=shared requires external linking'
[!GOOS:linux] skip

env GO111MODULE=off
env CGO_ENABLED=1
# A cache apiece, so the second install links a shared object of its own
# rather than reusing the first. Comparing a hit against its own source
# proves nothing about reproducibility.
env GOCACHE=$WORK/cache1
mkdir $GOCACHE
go install -trimpath -buildvcs=false -buildmode=shared -pkgdir=pkgdir1 runtime

env GOCACHE=$WORK/cache2
mkdir $GOCACHE
go install -trimpath -buildvcs=false -buildmode=shared -pkgdir=pkgdir2 runtime
[GOOS:linux] cmp -q pkgdir1/libruntime.so pkgdir2/libruntime.so
